newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips end slightly higher ahead of Fed chief's testimony.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips end slightly higher ahead of Fed chief's testimony.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed slightly higher Monday after a day of indecisive trading as Wall Street braced for Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's congressional testimony on Tuesday.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 16.26 points at 7,906.72.
In the broader market, declining issues swamped advances 2-1 on moderate volume of 463 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
